description: Sets the topic for a conversation.

channel.description: Conversation to set the topic of.

topic.description: The new topic string. Does not support formatting or linkification.

example_request:
curl -X POST "https://slack.com/api/conversations.setTopic" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{
       "channel": "C1234567890",
       "topic": "Apply topically for best effects"
     }'
